# The Unposed Story

> Candid wedding photography and cinematic wedding films studio based in Mumbai, India, founded by Sandip Lade. Covers weddings, pre-wedding shoots, haldi, mehendi, sangeet and bridal portraits across Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Pune, pan-India and destination weddings.

## Key facts
- Founder & lead photographer: Sandip Lade
- Based in: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Service areas: Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Pune, pan-India, destination weddings
- Style: candid, documentary, emotion-led, with traditional coverage of rituals and family groups
- Wedding collections: Essential from ₹35,000 per day; Silver from ₹55,000; Gold from ₹85,000; Platinum from ₹1,35,000
- Every collection includes professional editing and an online gallery
- Contact: WhatsApp / phone +91 70452 78377 · weddings.theunposedstory@gmail.com · Instagram @theunposedstory
- Booking: share wedding date and city on WhatsApp; reply within 24 hours; date reserved on receipt of the booking advance

## Services
- [Wedding photography in Mumbai](https://theunposedstory.github.io/portfolio/wedding-photography/): candid + traditional photographers, 150–700 edited photos, albums in Gold and Platinum
- [Pre-wedding shoots in Mumbai](https://theunposedstory.github.io/portfolio/pre-wedding-shoot/): beaches, heritage forts and golden-hour locations; included in Platinum or booked separately
- [Cinematic wedding films](https://theunposedstory.github.io/portfolio/cinematic-wedding-films/): teaser (1–3 min), highlight film (10–25 min), full event video (1–3 hrs), Instagram reels, drone coverage
- [Haldi, mehendi & bridal photography](https://theunposedstory.github.io/portfolio/haldi-bridal-photography/): candid ritual coverage and relaxed bridal portraits
